children: C4 Therapeutics reported new biomarker data showing T‑cell activation from the cemsidomide Phase 1 trial and supportive preliminary Phase 1b data with elranatamab; the 75 µg combination dose was declared safe and the Phase 1b is advancing to 100 µg escalation and 75 µg expansion.
Phase 1 (n=62 at QD dose levels): cemsidomide + dex showed coordinated T‑cell activation and NK cell reprogramming; highest doses (75 µg, 100 µg) had enhanced immune function and compelling ORRs.

Phase 1b biomarker data (first two patients): cemsidomide drove expansion/activation of CD8+ effector memory T cells (elevated HLA‑DR, Granzyme‑B) and prevented increases in exhaustion markers (PD‑1, TIM‑3, LAG3).
Safety: following a six‑patient safety cohort, the safety review committee declared the 75 µg cemsidomide + elranatamab dose safe; expansion at 75 µg and escalation to 100 µg are underway.
Clinical timeline: data from all Phase 1b cohorts are expected in mid‑2027; Phase 2 MOMENTUM (100 µg RP2D) enrollment expected to complete Q1 2027 with initial ORR data in 2H 2027.

title: C4 Therapeutics presents Phase 1 biomarker gains for cemsidomide; 75 µg combo dose with elranatamab declared safe
